VIDEO SCRIPT: CONSERVING WILD ANIMALS
Grade: Grade 6 · Subject: AGRICULTURE

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Conserving Wild Animals. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Domestic vs wild
• Be kind
• Stay safe

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Cow = domestic
• Lion = wild
• Wash hands after touching animals

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• List 5 domestic and 5 wild animals found in Kenya.
• Draw one animal and label how it moves.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Conserving Wild Animals.”

— CBC Learn · Video Hub script aligned to lesson + revision
